1.title: Trump Signs Executive Orders Targeting Birthright Citizenship and ‘Birth Tourism’
1.summary: The orders come after the Supreme Court ruled June 30 that President Trump’s previous efforts to end birthright citizenship were unconstitutional.

2.title: Spokane Arson Suspect Had History of Setting Fires, Prosecutors Say
2.summary: The man charged with setting one of the three destructive blazes in eastern Washington this month told detectives he had started two dozen fires in the last year, an affidavit said.

3.title: One Killed in Fire Started by Man Who Said He Lit It by Accident
3.summary: The authorities said they found a body inside a burned home near Sacramento. A man was charged this week with causing the blaze by operating equipment that produced sparks.

4.title: Trump imposes 15% tariff on key chip material to counter China
4.summary: The move aims to counter Chinese producers, which hold a monopoly in the global polysilicon production.

5.title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
5.summary: A New Mexico judge ordered the Instagram, Facebook and Whatsapp parent company to pay another $567m for the way it has harmed children.

6.title: Two people convicted in relation to death of French streamer
6.summary: Raphaël Graven, 46, died in August 2025, with his death live broadcast on the streaming platform Kick.
